newsitem.title: JAPAN: A&Cmos debuts on Japan OTC second section.
newsitem.headline: A&Cmos debuts on Japan OTC second section.

text.p: Shares in A&Cmos Inc, a Tokyo-based integrated circuit developer and maker, made their debut on the second section of the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Wednesday, trading above the public offering price.
It was the second firm to go public on the new section, following the flotation of ATL Systems Inc earlier this month.
The A&Cmos share price stood at 255,000 yen at 0104 GMT, after firming briefly to 299,000. It opened at 266,000 yen.
This was well above the public offering price of 200,000 yen.
The second section is designed to help venture businesses, especially research-oriented and high-tech firms, go public by offering simpler registration procedures and requirements.
